battles.title: Major Battles
battles.subtitle: Key engagements of World War II

characters.title: Key Leaders
characters.subtitle: Influential figures of World War II

weapons.title: Weapons & Equipment
weapons.subtitle: Military technology of World War II

messerschmitt.name: Messerschmitt Bf 109
messerschmitt.description: The standard German fighter aircraft throughout World War II, known for its agility and speed.

spitfire.name: Supermarine Spitfire
spitfire.description: British single-seat fighter aircraft that was crucial in the Battle of Britain.

tiger.name: Tiger I
tiger.description: German heavy tank equipped with a powerful 88mm gun, feared by Allied forces.

sherman.name: M4 Sherman
sherman.description: American medium tank that formed the backbone of Allied armored forces.

t34.name: T-34
t34.description: Soviet medium tank that proved decisive on the Eastern Front.

zero.name: Mitsubishi A6M Zero
zero.description: Japanese carrier-based fighter with exceptional maneuverability and range.

yamato.name: Yamato
yamato.description: Japanese battleship, the heaviest and most powerful ever built.

arizona.name: USS Arizona
arizona.description: American battleship sunk during the attack on Pearl Harbor.

flak88.name: 8.8 cm Flak 18/36
flak88.description: German 88mm anti-aircraft gun, also highly effective against tanks.

katusha.name: BM-13 Katyusha
katusha.description: Soviet multiple rocket launcher mounted on trucks.

mp40.name: MP 40
mp40.description: German submachine gun widely used by infantry.

garand.name: M1 Garand
garand.description: American semi-automatic rifle, standard issue for US forces.

invasion_poland.title: Germany Invades Poland
invasion_poland.description: Nazi Germany launches invasion of Poland, beginning World War II in Europe.

invasion_soviet.title: Soviet Union Invades Poland
invasion_soviet.description: Soviet forces invade Poland from the east, following secret protocol with Germany.

declare_war.title: Britain and France Declare War
declare_war.description: Britain and France declare war on Germany after ultimatum expires.

invasion_france.title: Germany Invades France
invasion_france.description: Germany launches Blitzkrieg against France and Low Countries.

dunkirk.title: Evacuation at Dunkirk
dunkirk.description: Operation Dynamo evacuates over 338,000 Allied soldiers from Dunkirk.

surrender_france.title: France Surrenders
surrender_france.description: France signs armistice with Germany, establishing Vichy regime.

battle_britain.title: Battle of Britain
battle_britain.description: Royal Air Force defeats Luftwaffe in aerial combat over Britain.

barbarossa.title: Operation Barbarossa
barbarossa.description: Germany invades Soviet Union, launching largest military operation in history.

pearl_harbor.title: Attack on Pearl Harbor
pearl_harbor.description: Japan attacks US Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor, Hawaii.

usa_enters.title: United States Enters War
usa_enters.description: US Congress declares war on Japan following Pearl Harbor attack.

midway.title: Battle of Midway
midway.description: US Navy defeats Japanese fleet in decisive carrier battle.

el_alamein.title: Second Battle of El Alamein
el_alamein.description: British Eighth Army defeats Axis forces in North Africa.

stalingrad.title: Battle of Stalingrad
stalingrad.description: Soviet forces encircle and destroy German Sixth Army.

kursk.title: Battle of Kursk
kursk.description: Largest tank battle in history; Soviet victory ends German offensive capability.

italy_surrenders.title: Italy Surrenders
italy_surrenders.description: Italy capitulates to Allies after Armistice of Cassibile.

dday.title: D-Day Invasion
dday.description: Allied forces land in Normandy, opening Western Front.

paris.title: Liberation of Paris
paris.description: Free French forces liberate Paris from German occupation.

bulge.title: Battle of the Bulge
bulge.description: German offensive in Ardennes fails despite initial gains.

leningrad.title: Siege of Leningrad Ends
leningrad.description: 900-day siege ends as Soviet forces lift German blockade.

vistula.title: Vistula-Oder Offensive
vistula.description: Soviet forces advance into Poland and eastern Germany.

okinawa.title: Battle of Okinawa
okinawa.description: US forces capture Okinawa after 82-day campaign.

mussolini.title: Mussolini Executed
mussolini.description: Italian partisans execute Benito Mussolini near Lake Como.

hitler.title: Hitler Commits Suicide
hitler.description: Adolf Hitler dies by suicide in his Berlin bunker.

germany_surrenders.title: Germany Surrenders
germany_surrenders.description: Germany signs unconditional surrender; V-E Day celebrated.

hiroshima.title: Atomic Bomb on Hiroshima
hiroshima.description: US drops first atomic bomb on Hiroshima, Japan.

nagasaki.title: Atomic Bomb on Nagasaki
nagasaki.description: US drops second atomic bomb on Nagasaki, Japan.

japan_surrenders.title: Japan Announces Surrender
japan_surrenders.description: Emperor Hirohito broadcasts surrender announcement to Japanese people.

tokyo_surrender.title: Formal Surrender Ceremony
tokyo_surrender.description: Japan signs surrender aboard USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay; V-J Day.
